function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If omitted, mandates of all statuses will be retrieved.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.content:
A **mandate** is a formal authorization or directive that gives someone the power or responsibility to act on behalf of another party. It can take many forms depending on the context:

| Context | What a mandate typically means |
|---------|--------------------------------|
| **Legal/Contractual** | A written or verbal agreement that authorizes one person (the agent) to perform specific actions for another (the principal). For example, a power‑of‑attorney document allows the agent to sign contracts, manage finances, or make decisions on the principal’s behalf. |
| **Financial/Banking** | A standing instruction that directs a bank or payment service to automatically transfer funds from one account to another at regular intervals. Common examples include direct debits for utility bills, pension contributions, or subscription services. |
| **Corporate Governance** | A directive issued by a board of directors or shareholders that empowers executives or committees to make certain decisions within defined limits. |
| **Political** | An endorsement or support from voters or a governing body that gives a candidate or policy the “authority” to pursue a particular agenda. |

In short, a mandate is a formal, often legally binding, permission that delegates authority and responsibility from one entity to another.
